answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. A newcomer posts a 60-unit deposit, names a sponsor, and the link joins the graph. Each identity carries a pigment mark, so a star cluster sharing one sponsor stands out. Peers may dispute a suspect link; a fake slashes both deposits, marked by an opal seal. Making 100 fakes locks 6000 units. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards, while watchers scan it like a raven scans a field.
